name: Missoula 2021
information:
Please be familiar with the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/), the current [WCA Safety Policy](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/policies/external/Competition%20Safety.pdf), the [WCA Code of Conduct](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/Code%20of%20Conduct.pdf) and our [Risk Management Plan](https://docs.google.com/document/d/1O48n_Cnevc4GRxklMjXarGditoxEdlNK/edit?usp=sharing&ouid=103125574022018881465&rtpof=true&sd=true).

## Registrants will be accepted in the order that they pay, not the order that they register. Please be patient with us as we manually accept all eligible competitors.
## Competitors may only bring one guest maximum.
## Spectators who are not associated with a registered competitor will NOT be permitted to enter the venue.
